title: Crispy Lamb Kebab
description: A Saudi Arabian-inspired dish featuring tender lamb, crispy on the outside, served with a side of fresh herbs.

ingredients.name: Lamb
ingredients.notes: Shoulder or leg cuts work well

ingredients.name: Arabian Spices
ingredients.notes: Mix of cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and cardamom

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together Arabian Spices, Lemon Juice, and Garlic.
2. Add the lamb to the marinade and mix until coated.
3. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
5. Thread lamb onto skewers, leaving space between each piece.
6. Brush kebabs with oil and season with Salt.
7. Grill kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
8. Garnish with crispy onions and serve immediately.
9. Serve with a side of fresh herbs, such as parsley or cilantro.
